text: Hi, boys and girls, 我是来自华东师范大学第四附属中学的陈嘉颖老师。Today, we are going to talk about different English learning styles.This is Mike.He has difficulty in learning English words.Mike says, learning English words is a little difficult for me.I always copy the words to memorize them.However, it doesn't work.I still can't use the words correctly and properly.Do you have good ways to help Mike learn English?Perhaps, today we can work together to help him find some good methods.Yiming and his classmates are also talking about their learning methods.Methods here means the ways of learning.Please take out your worksheet and look at task one.Choose proper words or phrases to complete their talks.Let's start from Yiming.How does he learn English?Asher, suppose you are Yiming.Could you please share your answers with us?I like to do hands-on activities.That's right.Hands-on means doing something rather than just talking about it.I always take part in the fun activities and I like to move around the classroom.If I work with others, I will learn better.Well done, Asher.How about Lindong?I always listen to the teacher carefully.I often read aloud to remember what I've learned.What's Lu Yao's learning methods, Rose?It's easier for me to understand when I see pictures and charts.I always draw mind maps to remember new words.Besides, I watch movies to practice English.Good job, Rose.The three students share their methods of learning English.Could you figure out their learning styles?Yiming enjoys learning through hands-on experiences and movement.We can infer that he prefers learning by doing.And Lindong always learns through listening and speaking.He probably likes learning by hearing.How about Lu Yao?She always learns through seeing and prefers visual aids.Yes, she likes learning by seeing.Everyone has unique way of learning.When we know our learning styles, we can study better and learn more effectively.Are you curious about your learning styles?Now look at task two in your worksheet.Do a quiz to know your own learning style.Mike did the quiz as well.These are his answers.He prefers listening to stories for fun.When he is not sure how to spell a word, he usually writes it down to see if it looks right.He likes music class best.Mike prefers listening to music after class.When Mike meets new people, he remembers their names instead of their faces.And when he gives others directions, he will tell them to follow him and he will show them the way.Now count how many A's, B's, and C's you have got.How many A's, B's, and C's has Mike got?Yes, he has got one A, four B's, and one C.Now could you tell what your learning style is according to the notes?I'm sure you have known your learning style.How about Mike?Could you tell his?Yes, he has got four B's.You can know that he likes learning by hearing.Now please discuss with your classmates.Now please try to find out their learning styles and their specific learning methods.Here is the dialogue between Rose and Asher.Rose, what's your learning style?I prefer learning by seeing.I enjoy reading English books.And drawing mind maps is effective for me to remember new words.How about you, Asher?Oh, what a coincidence.I like learning by seeing as well.Watching movies is a perfect way to practice my English.And you just mentioned drawing mind maps.That's a good idea.I will try this way.Learning from your classmates with different learning styles is important.Because it helps you become a better learner and understand different ways of thinking.It's like having a team with different superpowers.Everyone brings something unique.And together we can learn and achieve more.Let's go back to Mike.Let's go back to Mike's problem.He always copies English words to memorize them.But it doesn't work.I think it's because he didn't really know his learning style.And he didn't use proper learning methods.So what can we do now?Right.We can give him some suggestions to help him become better at learning English.Let's help him together with the learning methods we have learned today.What do you need to do when you give Mike suggestions?Rose?We should give Mike some practical learning ways based on his learning style.Great.So please remember to figure out Mike's learning style first.And offer at least two learning methods based on his learning style.Don't forget to use proper verbs or verbal phrases to show the learning methods.Now please take out your worksheet and finish task 3.Let's get started.
